Proposition
↗ prop:tangential-connection-compatible-metric ↗ prop:tangential-connection-symmetric 1. ch5:5.12

  1. The Levi-Civita connection of a (pseudo-)Euclidean space is its Euclidean connection.

  2. The Levi-Civita connection of an embedded (pseudo-)Riemannian submanifold of a (pseudo-)Euclidean space is its tangential connection $\nabla ^\top $.

Proof

\sketch The Euclidean connection is symmetric and compatible with every pseudo-Euclidean metric. Part (b) follows from Propositions 2 and 5, together with uniqueness.

□
